I little whiles back I wrote up this guide but never shared it. I think now is a good time to share it and I hope it encourages some discussions in this sub. The tips have helped me immensely both as a new player and at a higher rank and it is worth a read in my opinion. Enjoy!

Dealing With RNG and Emotions In Hearthstone

Written By Metaxu

Index:

  1. Playing With and Around RNG - Technical View
  2. Emotions and Frustration - Consequences and Prevention
  3. Conclusion

Section One: Playing With and Around RNG

What To Expect: In this section I will be covering the technical effects that RNG has on Hearthstone and how to deal with RNG when playing, in order to make the best possible decisions. If you are having trouble with frustration in regards to RNG, section two will be more catered to this.

Introduction to RNG and its effect on the game

RNG can be as simple as drawing a card from your deck or as complicated as calculating the odds of a Piloted Shredder dropping a Doomsayer to win you the game. Regardless of whether or not you like it, RNG is a fundamental part of the Hearthstone experience. RNG stands for 'Random Number Generator' and is used to describe an effect which has a random outcome, such as the situation described above. Although some may say that RNG ruins the Hearthstone experience, a pro player knows how to play around RNG and make the fates roll in their favor to secure the game.

Playing around RNG

The trick to successfully playing around RNG is in numbers. All RNG situations can be turned into percent chance which should influence your decisions into making the game swing in your favor. Consider the following situation: Your opponent has a Frostwolf Grunt and a Azure Drake on their side of the field. You have an Implosion in hand with only four mana available. Without thinking, a player may make the decision to Implosion the Drake and hope to hit for 4 damage. Next turn, they would be able to kill the Grunt with two of the remaining 4 imps for maximum value and efficiency. The flaw in this plan however comes from the numbers and math involved in RNG. Although this is a simple example, we see that Implosion has the chance to hit 2 and 3 damage. This means the odds of success is 1/3, roughly 33%. If this doesn't sound too bad, the odds of failure are 66% and leaves two minions on your opponents side. This method can be applied to all RNG situations and making decisions based on highest mathematical value for your benefit is an effective way to keep RNG under control and in your favor.

Section Two: Emotions and Frustration - Consequences and Prevention

What to Expect: In this section I will be discussing how RNG can effect your game from an emotional point of view as opposed to a technical side of view. I will go over the consequences and prevention strategies for frustration while playing.

Introduction to Frustration and Emotions

Although RNG can be played around from a statistics based standpoint, sometimes greedy plays are awarded by fully random chance. After playing hearthstone for some time most players will encounter situations where the odds were exponentially against them yet greedy plays from the opponent still pay off. Just imagining playing Onyxia on an empty board only to have it killed by an enemy Ragnaros the next turn. This is enough to make the blood of most players boil in rage. The key to being successful in Hearthstone throughout the time you play today and for as long as RNG remains a theme in the game is to be able to come to terms with bad RNG and be able to effectively deal with negative emotions which may have consequences on your game play.

Consequences of frustration and negative emotions

RNG is the leading factor towards player frustration in most cases due to the players inability to control it, no matter how skilled they may be. Outplaying an opponent all game only to be punished by an unfortunate Unstable Portal can lead to rising frustration extremely quickly. One of the main reasons to avoid frustration is the list of negative effects it can have on your game play. When one is frustrated, they exhibit short thinking, rash actions, and are more susceptible to becoming increasingly angry. The consequences of short thinking can make a direct negative effect on your game play. Hearthstone is a game of skill and one which requires a lot of thinking in some cases. In many of these cases the correct play it not always obvious and making the first play you see (whether or not you realize you are doing it) can lose you the game. This can relate back to increasing frustration as you may be telling yourself you are making the right play, only to see it fail. Acting rash is another direct consequence which follows many of the same steps of short thinking, the two go hand in hand and are a deadly combination which can seriously effect your game play. Negative emotions such as these can put you in a viscous cycle of increasing frustration which may lead you to lose many games and have you feeling trapped.

How to deal with frustrations and negative emotions

As before stated, dealing with / coming to terms with RNG and emotions is key to success and recovery from the frustration cycle referred to in the previous paragraph and can be your savior when trying to ladder. The first trick to helping yourself deal with negative feelings (whether they come from RNG or some other aspect) is to tell yourself it is in fact just a game. I cannot stress this point enough. There are many other things in the world which are more important and justifiable to be angry at. This reminder may work for some but not for others, the key to dealing with these negative feelings is mostly a personal issue which can be solved by something different for everyone. Although I cannot tell you what will calm you down or help you recover from a loss streak, I can list some options which you can try when feeling angry to help with the frustration.

  1. Set a goal: Setting a goal works for some people as playing towards certain achievements motivates them past the amount that frustration brings them down.

  2. Listen to music: I personally like this method to deal with frustration. Music can help relax or 'Chill Out' some people to a point where they can play again after listening for a while to calm themselves down.

  3. VENT!: Venting to someone IRL, online, or even your computer monitor (For some folks) can help reduce tension and frustration by verbally letting it out or typing out your frustration. When people relate to your frustration, this usually helps by reminding you that others have been in this situation, even pro's.

  4. Do something else: While this may seem obvious, so many times have I told myself to keep playing even through I exhibit the signs of frustration, ultimately decreasing my play performance. If I had only stopped, I would have been able to cool off by doing something else and then come back later when I was no longer frustrated.

  5. Get your groove back in casual: Whether it be a janky combo deck or your tier one ladder deck, casual is a great place to cool off if you're not too frustrated and have been on a bad streak. Winning a couple games in casual and regaining your 'groove' is a great way to get your confidence back and hop back on the ranked ladder.

Section 3 - Conclusion

RNG is a part of Hearthstone that one cannot escape. The most common misconception is that one SHOULD escape the RNG and that it is a no skill mechanic which rewards bad plays. I hope that after reading this guide you know that this is not true. Although it has the potential to reward bad plays, RNG can be played around using statistics and math to insure the highest probability of success for your side of the game. While this is effective, it is not a sure-fire method to win every game, that is impossible. In order to keep playing your best, a good player needs to effectively deal with their emotions and frustration using a method they deem best for them and over time come to terms with RNG as a fundamental part of the game they are playing. When this happens, one will not get frustrated as easily and can break themselves out of a bad streak, ready to jump back on the ladder! I hope that this guide has given you an insight on how to properly play RNG in your favor as well as ideas for insuring negative emotions do not affect your game play. Good luck and see you in game!
